content: Ngehi eri rongada Koht eh kapitie laudida, mahsanih, “Kohdo wasaht, kumwail kan me pahn kaloke kahnimwo. Kumwail wahdo noumwail tehtehn pei kan.”

Ohl wenemen ahpw mwadangete pedolong sang maslikin ewen kehl ni paliepeng en Tehnpas Sarawio, emenemen irail weuwa nah tehtehn pei. Ohl emen ahpw iang irail me mi nan likou linen, e weuwa mehkot me e pahn ntingki. Irail koaros ahpw kohdo oh kesihnenda limwahn pei sarawi pronso.
Marain lingaling en Koht en Israel ahpw kohdahsang pohn menmour ko
wasa me e mihmi ie, oh mwekidlahng ni wenihmwen Tehnpas Sarawio. KAUN-O ahpw malipe ohl me mi nan likou lineno, mahsanih,
“Kohwei nan kahnimw en Serusalem pwon oh kihdiong kilel ehu ni temwen aramas koaros me pahtoulahr oh milahr nan apwal pwehki soahng saut akan me wiewiawi nan kahnimwet.”
I ahpw rongada Koht eh mahsanihong ohl teiko, “Kumwail idawehnewei nan kahnimwo oh kemehla aramas akan. Kumwail kemehla koaros; kaleke kumwail mahkohng emen.

Kumwail kemehla ohl mah kan, mwahnakapw akan, peinakapw akan, ihn kan, oh seri kan. Ahpw kumwail dehpa sair mehmen me kilel mi nan temwe. Kumwail tepida wasaht nan Tehnpasei Sarawiet.” Irail eri tepida kemehla kaun ako me kesikesihnen nan Tehnpas Sarawio.
Koht ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail kasaminehla Tehnpas Sarawio. Kumwail audehkihla paliweren me melahr akan nan kehlo. Nna, kumwail tepida doadoahk!” Irail eri tepida kemehla aramas nan kahnimwo.

Nindokon kamaramas eh wiewiawi, I kelekelehpw mwo, I ahpw poarikihdi meseiet nanpwel oh weriwerki, “Maing KAUN, Wasa Lapalahpie, ia duwe, komwi uhdahn engieng pahn Serusalem me kahrehda omwi pahn kemehla aramas koaros me luhwehdi nan Israel?”

Koht ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “Mehn Israel oh Suda wiadahr dihp kan me inenen suwed. Re kemelahr aramas wasa koaros nan sahpwo oh kadirehkilahr Serusalem dihp. Re nda me ngehi, KAUN-O, keselahr sapwarailo oh dene I sohte mahsanih irail.
Ahpw I sohte pahn poakeirailla; I pahn dupukohng irail dahme re wiahiong meteikan.”
Eri, ohl me mi nan likou lineno ahpw pwurodo oh pakairkihong KAUN-O, “I kapwaiadahr sapwellimomwi koasoandi.”
